# DustConfig

`jaff.physics.dust.config.DustConfig`

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Dust (`[network.dust]`); the table enables the dust module.

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rv` | `float` | Total-to-selective extinction ratio R_V selecting the tabulated dust model: `3.1`, `4.0` or `5.5`. |
| `u_reduction` | `str` | Dust cross-section attenuating the radiation density: `"extinction"`, `"absorption"`, `"scattering"`, `"transport"` or `"none"`. |
| `f_reduction` | `str` | Dust cross-section attenuating the radiation flux (same choices). |
| `pe` | `PhotoelectricEmissionConfig` | Photoelectric emission settings. |
